confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'The fact that your lettuce and yoghurts are frozen solid strongly suggests cold air isn't circulating properly, which usually means the evaporator coils inside the freezer are iced over. The only way to confirm this is a full manual defrost'

rationale: The assistant opened with an unnecessary 'switch it off and unplug it' and pushed a disruptive full manual defrost on a confident evaporator-icing theory that fits poorly with a frost-free unit whose freezer works normally, only reaching the correct simple checks (vents, overpacking) after the customer pushed back. It never asked about the thermostat setting (the customer volunteered it), never suggested a fridge thermometer, and never asked for the model. When one yoghurt still froze after correction it offered a vague 'holding onto cold air' explanation and pointed back to a defrost fault rather than a possible damper/thermostat fault with engineer referral, so the customer ends in an improved but not properly guided position.
